fields.label: Enable Order-wise COGS
fields.description: Off = stock ledger behaves exactly like stock the ERP platform. Nothing in this app touches valuation.

fields.label: Costing Mode
fields.options:
Pegged Batch Valuation
Pegged PO Rate
Default Valuation
fields.description: Pegged Batch Valuation is the recommended mode. It uses the ERP platform's own batch valuation so the GL always reconciles.

fields.label: If Pegged Batch Is Short
fields.options:
Block Delivery
Fallback to Default Valuation with Warning
Allow and Flag Variance
fields.default: Fallback to Default Valuation with Warning

fields.label: Allow Manual Batch Override
fields.description: Let users change the auto-selected batch on the Delivery Note.

fields.label: Procurement Document Flow
fields.description: Some clients raise a Purchase Receipt then a Purchase Invoice. Others skip the receipt and post a single Purchase Invoice with Update Stock, which hits payables and inventory together. Both are supported.

fields.label: Inward Flow
fields.options:
Auto Detect
Purchase Receipt then Purchase Invoice
Purchase Invoice with Update Stock

fields.label: Enforce Purchase Receipt
fields.description: Block Purchase Invoices raised directly against a Purchase Order without a receipt.

fields.label: Default Update Stock on Purchase Invoice
Create Batch On
fields.options: Stock Inward Document
fields.description: Batches are created on the Purchase Receipt, or on the Purchase Invoice when Update Stock is ticked. The sales order number still appears in the batch ID through the naming composition below.

fields.label: Batch ID Composition
fields.options: Batch Naming Component
fields.description: Rows are concatenated in order using the separator above. Example: BT - HPLAP - 0012 - 001

fields.label: Set Expiry From Item Shelf Life
Enable Split
fields.description: One Sales Order carrying several brands produces one Material Request / Purchase Order per brand.

fields.label: Split By
fields.options:
Brand
Supplier
Brand and Supplier
Item Group
Default Supplier of Item

fields.label: Split Applies To
fields.options:
Material Request and Purchase Order
Purchase Order Only
Material Request Only

fields.label: Purchase Cost Visibility
fields.description: Copies the pegged purchase rate onto sales documents so margin is visible everywhere. This never changes the stock ledger, so it can run with Enable Order-wise COGS switched off.

fields.label: Cost Rate To Show
fields.options:
effective_cost_rate
purchase_rate
received_rate
landed_rate
quoted_rate
fields.description: Falls back down the chain (landed, received, ordered, quoted, then item last purchase rate) when the chosen field is empty.

fields.label: Overwrite Existing Values
fields.description: Off preserves a rate a user has already set on the row.

fields.label: Show Unit Margin and Margin Percent
Additional Fields To Copy
fields.description: Pick any field from Order Cost Peg and the row it should land on. Target custom fields are created automatically on migrate.

fields.label: Fields
fields.options: Cost Visibility Field

fields.label: Consolidated Procurement
fields.description: Aggregate open demand across many sales orders and material requests into one bulk purchase order per brand. Larger quantity is what earns the vendor discount.

fields.label: Consolidate By
fields.options:
Brand
Brand and Supplier
Item Group
Supplier

fields.label: Allocate Receipts By
fields.options:
Earliest Required Date
Earliest Order Date
Pro Rata
Largest Order First
fields.description: How a consolidated receipt is shared out across the sales orders it serves.

fields.label: Batch Identity When Consolidated
fields.options:
Per Purchase Order
Per Sales Order
Per Receipt Line
fields.description: A consolidated batch serves several sales orders, so a sales order number in the batch ID would be misleading. Per Purchase Order is correct here.

fields.label: Block Delivery Beyond Allocation
fields.description: Stops one sales order consuming another order's share of a shared batch.

fields.label: Procurement Document Policy
fields.description: Decides whether a demand group goes straight to a purchase order or must be quoted first. Rows are evaluated by priority, first match wins.

fields.label: Default Path
fields.options:
Direct Purchase Order
Supplier Quotation then Purchase Order
Request for Quotation then Purchase Order

fields.label: Enforce
fields.description: Off means the policy advises but does not block. Start here during rollout.

fields.label: Policies
fields.options: Procurement Policy

fields.label: Invoice Add-on Items
fields.description: Items added at delivery or invoice time that were not on the Sales Order, such as a RAM or SSD upgrade.

fields.label: Add-on Item Groups
fields.description: Comma separated. Leave blank to treat any unmatched line as an add-on.

fields.label: Add-on Costing
fields.options:
Default Valuation
Own Peg If Available
Attribute to Parent Sales Order Line

fields.label: Report Attribution
fields.options:
Show as Separate Line
Roll Up Into Parent Item

fields.label: Cost Variance Posting
fields.description: Only used in Pegged PO Rate mode. Stock posts at real valuation, and the difference to the pegged rate is journalised so the ledger stays reconcilable.

fields.label: Cost Variance Account
fields.options: Account

fields.label: Cost Center
fields.options: Cost Center

fields.label: Part Numbers and Specifications
fields.description: A part number is an Item. Its specification is structured, bilingual and printable.

fields.label: Spec Print Language
fields.options:
English
Arabic
Bilingual

fields.label: Show Key Specs on Invoice Line
fields.description: Keep this off for ZATCA. Full specs belong on the annexure, not the invoice line description.

fields.label: Generate As-Built Configuration
fields.description: Recomputes the delivered specification from add-on lines on the same document.

fields.label: Supplier Resolution Order
fields.options:
Item Supplier then Item Default
Item Default then Item Supplier
fields.description: Different part numbers of the same brand often come from different distributors.

fields.label: Part Substitution
fields.description: Handles a manufacturer shipping a superseded part number against an open purchase order.

fields.label: Substitution Handling
fields.options:
Prompt
Automatic
Forbidden

fields.label: Default Report Profile
fields.options: Profitability Report Profile

fields.label: Maintenance and Cleanup
fields.description: One-click teardown of a full order cycle for UAT. It cancels and deletes submitted accounting and stock documents. Keep the toggle off on production.

fields.label: Allow Destructive Cleanup
fields.description: Switch on only while tearing down test data, then switch off again.

fields.options: Irreversible. Cancelled and deleted documents cannot be restored. Always run Preview first and take a backup before running on any site that holds real data.

fields.label: Applicability
fields.description: Leave empty to apply the global mode everywhere. Add rows to run order-wise costing for some companies, item groups or brands only.

fields.label: Applicability
fields.options: Order Costing Applicability
